about: her_b's own correctives data (specs/her_b.json "correctives_conf"; correctives.load_conf): tools/body/correctives.json with the joints below put in by name. P1 R1 weights round 19.
solve_why: P1 R1 bake round 3: each shape's normal turn read from B's geometric normals averaged 8 times over the mesh (correctives.normal_delta smooth): the game keys lay B's posed points on A's facets, and their turn carried point by point drew a lit line and blotches down the front of her right deltoid at close and Look (with her relief off as well). On round_19's shapes: arm_hang_look_r turn p99 39 -> 19 deg, its edge angle p90/p99 18.7/69.3 -> 14.2/57.8 deg (rest 13.1/53.3); arm_hang_close_larm_l 18.8/81.3 -> 15.1/50.3.

joints.name: arm_hang
joints.why: P1 R1 weights round 19: the hanging arm keyed AT THE GAME POSE (correctives.game_a_key): B posed as the game poses it in a shot, laid on A's surface as the game poses A in the same shot (rest twins, where B's rest lies on A). The strip key (arm_hang 8 deg, fold fair) posed the trunk at rest and an arm the game never holds: her right arm hangs past it, the RBF clamped at 1 and the fair shape squared the cap (Look cap_r p95 14.8 mm off A, armpit_r 12.8). Keys: her right arm in the Look (worn by both arms, mirrored), her left arm in the Look and in the town close-up (arm back, elbow bent; mirrored onto the right when it takes that line). The right arm's close-up key is left out: 9.4 deg from the Look's, it made the RBF ill-conditioned (|M| 6.9, the Look shape at full weight 45 deg from its key); the Look shape alone holds the close-up within 1-3 mm. Mask from the upper arm's rest head: 2 cm under it, 11/12/12 cm, full inside half (the top of the cap up to the trapezius: at 11 cm tall the left cap kept 12 mm at its top). Round 27 (gate judge 1 item 5, the raised-arm deltoid peak in fights): three raised fight keys in the same RBF, so the solve holds the hang shapes at 0 there (before, arm_hang_close_larm fired 0.5-0.74 at fight_close 206, the arm out and back 21-29 deg from the close key in the clavicle's frame, and lifted the cap 20 mm off A): fight_stalker 302 right arm (the most raised, 92 deg from the torso's down), fight_close 206 left (76; the same pose as fight_stalker 366) and fight_close 342 left (79); 57-132 deg apart, 29+ from the hang keys. Left out: fight_close 206 right (13 deg from 206 left), fight_stalker 214 right (11 from 302).
